description: Header file defining functions for computing expm1f (exponential minus 1) with high accuracy, optimized for Metal shading language. Contains inline functions expm1f_scaled_unchecked and expm1f within namespace c10::metal.

methods.name: expm1f_scaled_unchecked
methods.description: Computes expm1(a) scaled by factor b with high precision, handling various ranges of input.

methods.name: expm1f
methods.description: Computes expm1(a) with handling for overflow and underflow, using expm1f_scaled_unchecked.
